score"},"titleIcon":"","title":{"original":"","normalized":""},"headingLevel":"h3","image":{"original":"","resized":"","preview":""},"description":{"original":"<p><strong>INFORMATION ON FACTORS ABOUT CREDIT HISTORY AND CREDIT SCORE</strong></p>\n<p>This document sets out the information required under the Republic of Armenia laws and regulations about the credit history and the credit score of customers during lending in Ameriabank CJSC (hereinafter “the Bank”) and the factors affecting them.</p>\n<p><strong>Credit History</strong> is the information on the customer’s financial obligations generated/processed by the Credit Bureau, which shows the customer’s debt, payments, payment habits or other data related to the customer’s obligations or their performance and the dynamics/history of such information. </p>\n<p>The credit history includes, in particular, the information required for customer identification, amount of each monetary obligation of the customer, annual interest rate, outstanding liabilities, order and terms of payments, payment delays, guarantees issued to the third parties, information about the liabilities of the parties affiliated with the customer (in depersonalized form) and the information about credit history inquiries.  </p>\n<p>As a rule, financial organizations use the credit history to assess the customer’s monetary (credit) obligations, guarantees issued to the third parties, to consider the possibilities of lending at the customer’s or bank’s initiative and to submit lending offers to the customer.</p>\n<p>Based on the customer’s consent the Bank sends an inquiry to ACRA Credit Bureau. The information about the credit history is reflected in the credit report which covers the customer’s credit history for the most recent 5 years.</p>\n<p>The Customer’s credit history is available at <a href=\"http://www.acra.am/\">http://www.acra.am/</a>.</p>\n<p><strong>Credit score</strong> is the quantified measure of the customer’s borrowing capacity and creditworthiness.</p>\n<p>The Bank uses its own system to assess the borrowing capacity and creditworthiness for lending to customers. The factors affecting it are as follows:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Credit history</strong><strong>․ </strong>The quantity and amount of existing loans, frequency of applying for loans, positive credit history (no payment delays in the credit history, high quality of loan service) can help improve the credit score and make a positive decision on lending, while a bad credit history (payment delays in the credit history, persistent nature of such delays) can serve as a basis for reducing the credit score, rejecting a new loan application or reviewing it on more stringent terms.</li>\n<li><strong>Employment, income and work experience</strong>. Stable job and income can help improve the credit score and make a positive decision on lending. Unstable or non-permanent job or income can serve as a basis for reducing the credit score and rejecting a new loan application or reviewing it on more stringent terms.</li>\n<li><strong>Credit burden.</strong>High credit burden and its big share in the income can serve as a basis for reducing the credit score and rejecting a new loan application or reviewing it on more stringent terms, while a low credit burden and its small share in the income can help improve the credit score and make a positive decision on lending</li>\n<li><strong>FICO Score. FICO Score</strong> is a scoring system that provides a numerical value of credit risk through statistic research and analysis of the customer’s credit history. It is a key used by lenders worldwide to assess creditworthiness and financial risks. Details are available at <a href=\"https://acra.am/սքոր/\">acra.am</a>.</li>\n<li><strong>Other information about the Customer </strong>    </li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>The importance of credit history and credit score</strong></p>\n<p>Credit history and credit score are essential for making a decision on lending, enabling banks and credit organizations to assess the credit risk of the customer during lending and predict the customer’s proper fulfillment of customer’s monetary obligations and its likelihood.</p>\n<p><strong>Wrong or incomplete credit history </strong></p>\n<p>If there are wrong or incomplete data in the credit history, the customer can apply to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC (credit bureau) or directly to the financial organizations having provided the information to the Credit Bureau to correct or clarify such data.</p>\n<p>The procedure and details on applying to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC is available at www.<a href=\"https://acra.am/կապ-և-աջակցություն/հաճախորդի-իրավունքներ/\">acra.am</a>  </p>\n<p>Where wrong or incomplete information has been provided to the Credit Bureau by the Bank, the customer can apply to the Bank via any of the following channels:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>By sending an application to the Bank’s official email address</li>\n<li>By calling the Bank at 010/012 561111 phone numbers</li>\n<li>By sending a message via the Bank’s Online/Mobile Banking system</li>\n<li>By submitting an application at any of the Bank’s branches.</li>\n</ul>\n<p>The Bank will process the customer’s application in the manner and within the time frames defined by the Republic of Armenia laws and regulations, and/or the Bank’s internal regulations.</p>\n<p><strong>How to improve the credit history and credit score</strong></p>\n<p>To improve the credit history and credit score it is necessary to eliminate its root causes as soon as possible, in particular:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Make loan payments in accordance with the defined schedule, excluding any late payments and even 1-day overdue liabilities</li>\n<li>Limit the number and amount of provided guarantees, by repaying the overdue liabilities secured by guarantees, if possible</li>\n<li>Reduce the credit burden by repaying the outstanding liabilities</li>\n<li>Avoid submitting new loan applications frequently since credit history inquiries (other than for loan monitoring purposes) may negatively affect the customer’s Credit Score.</li>\n</ul>\n<p>Detailed information about the credit history (including wrong or incomplete information) and/or Credit Score is available on the following pages:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><u></u><a href=\"https://acra.am/%D5%AF%D5%A1%D5%BA-%D6%87-%D5%A1%D5%BB%D5%A1%D5%AF%D6%81%D5%B8%D6%82%D5%A9%D5%B5%D5%B8%D6%82%D5%B6/%D5%B0-%D5%BF-%D5%B0/?lang=en\">acra.am</a> –Support– Frequently Asked Questions</li>\n<li><a href=\"https://abcfinance.am/news/credit-history.html\">abcfinance.am</a></li>\n<li><u></u><a href=\"https://abcfinance.am/news/news_varkayinscore.html\">abcfinance.am</a></li>\n</ul>","normalized":"<p><strong>INFORMATION ON FACTORS ABOUT CREDIT HISTORY AND CREDIT SCORE</strong></p>\n<p>This Unstable or non-permanent job or income can serve as a basis for reducing the credit score and rejecting a new loan application or reviewing it on more stringent terms.</li>\n<li><strong>Credit burden.</strong>High credit burden and its big share in the income can serve as a basis for reducing the credit score and rejecting a new loan application or reviewing it on more stringent terms, while a low credit burden and its small share in the income can help improve the credit score and make a positive decision on lending</li>\n<li><strong>FICO Score. FICO Score</strong> is a scoring system that provides a numerical value of credit risk through statistic research and analysis of the customer’s credit history. It is a key used by lenders worldwide to assess creditworthiness and financial risks. Details are available at <a href=\"https://acra.am/սքոր/\">acra.am</a>.</li>\n<li><strong>Other information about the Customer </strong>    </li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>The importance of credit history and credit score</strong></p>\n<p>Credit history and credit score are essential for making a decision on lending, enabling banks and credit organizations to assess the credit risk of the customer during lending and predict the customer’s proper fulfillment of customer’s monetary obligations and its likelihood.</p>\n<p><strong>Wrong or incomplete credit history </strong></p>\n<p>If there are wrong or incomplete data in the credit history, the customer can apply to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC (credit bureau) or directly to the financial organizations having provided the information to the Credit Bureau to correct or clarify such data.</p>\n<p>The procedure and details on applying to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC is available at www.<a href=\"https://acra.am/կապ-և-աջակցություն/հաճախորդի-իրավունքներ/\">acra.am</a>  </p>\n<p>Where wrong or incomplete information has been provided to the Credit Bureau by the Bank, the customer can apply to the Bank via any of the following channels:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>By sending an application to the Bank’s official email address</li>\n<li>By calling the Bank at 010/012 561111 phone numbers</li>\n<li>By sending a message via the Bank’s Online/Mobile Banking system</li>\n<li>By submitting an application at any of the Bank’s branches.</li>\n</ul>\n<p>The Bank will process the customer’s application in the manner and within the time frames defined by the Republic of Armenia laws and regulations, and/or the Bank’s internal regulations.</p>\n<p><strong>How to improve the credit history and credit score</strong></p>\n<p>To improve the credit history and credit score it is necessary to eliminate its root causes as soon as possible, in particular:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Make loan payments in accordance with the defined schedule, excluding any late payments and even 1-day overdue liabilities</li>\n<li>Limit the number and amount of provided guarantees, by repaying the overdue liabilities secured by guarantees, if possible</li>\n<li>Reduce the credit burden by repaying the outstanding liabilities</li>\n<li>Avoid submitting new loan applications frequently since credit history inquiries (other than for loan monitoring purposes) may negatively affect the customer’s Credit Score.</li>\n</ul>\n<p>Detailed information about the credit history (including wrong or incomplete information) and/or Credit Score is available on the following pages:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><u></u><a
